title: A value a mock offers in one list must work in every mock handler that takes it
rule: When a mock list gains an entry only in one mode (a language preset, a filter value), every handler that resolves that value must find it too: grep for the list's other readers. Test the round trip: pick the offered value and assert a result that holds families, not only that the list contains it.
rationale: E40.2 (#444): the wall added a Vietnamese preset to listLanguages only, the language filter looked in mockLanguages, so the offered chip returned no families.
